cards.card_text: We rejoice in God through Jesus, the One through whom we've now received reconciliation.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ, Not only that, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.
cards.snippet: …God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.

cards.card_text: If their rejection is the reconciliation of the world, he asks, what will their acceptance be?
cards.verse_text: For if their rejection is the reconciliation of the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?

cards.card_text: Paul writes that God has committed the message of reconciliation to us.
cards.verse_text: And He has committed to us the message of reconciliation.
cards.snippet: And He has committed to us the message of reconciliation.
